summary: This directory manages the core orchestration of the TypeScript static analysis pipeline, handling project initialization, file-level processing, and the persistence of analysis results through reading and writing metadata to the filesystem.
responsibilities: Initialize and maintain project-wide analysis context.
Orchestrate the analysis of individual TypeScript source files.
Persist and retrieve structured analysis metadata from storage.
Verify the integrity and consistency of analysis results across project runs.
relationships: The project context serves as the anchor for all analysis operations by providing necessary configuration and environment metadata.
File analysis results are built into a centralized index to allow for efficient lookup of symbols and documentation.
Persistence logic links raw source files to their corresponding metadata stored on the filesystem to facilitate caching and incremental analysis.
designDecisions: Centralized orchestration of the analysis lifecycle from initialization to disk persistence.
Use of standard JSON serialization for storing analysis results to ensure cross-platform compatibility.
Strict separation between project configuration loading and file-level analysis execution.
Integration of validation steps during result loading to ensure metadata integrity.
